descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-21 Hospital vs. Nursing-Home Context Switch · S28 「养老院 Save & Extract 和 Generate：耗时、模型，以及医生走开时的「generating」状态」 Nursing Home Save & Extract and Generate: time, model, and the 'generating' state while the physician moves on

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U9 Nursing Home has Save & Extract, a billing block and a Medications panel, all working (none were present in Run 6)（UAT TC-21；TFA-92599 AC 10） — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress

测试设计方法：性能（performance） — 量时间，看是不是在要求的秒数里。

Given Two NH residents, the first with a typed synthetic encounter; 10 cycles, NH only (the feature is mode-specific)

When Tap Save & Extract; tap Generate Note & Finish and immediately open the second resident; come back to the first

Then While away, the Post-Round tab shows a 'generating' state, and the note is there on return, or an explicit failure shows. Each step logs durationMs and providerMs and the model/provider (aiCallLog).

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Pass/Fail: the 'generating' state is shown and the note (or an explicit failure) is there on return (3.5). Timings are targets, not pass/fail (3.5): record total vs providerMs per step, and flag any run over 30 s where the non-AI share (total − providerMs) is the larger part, for review with Vikram. Model per step (3.9). NH Save Note timing is TC-10 S19. …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 PERF · 性能计时；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S28 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-21.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：PERF · 性能计时；辅助：AGENT · 浏览器 agent — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 dev 跑；来源：dev。
